final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and mainly narrowed the claim by reframing the same record. That clarification is relevant to precision, but it does not satisfy the governing policy. The admissible evidence still shows: a 1.5-point gap in a named regulated-customer use case, an open legal question on disclosure, and no evidence of disclosure, resolution, or approved risk acceptance before launch. Under the policy text, that is enough to keep the certification decision noncompliant. A caveated rationale may better describe business posture, but it is not enough for compliant_with_caveats here because the unresolved disclosure predicate itself remains unmet on the available record.
